```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)

ames_housing <- read.csv("AmesHousing.csv")
```


-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A

```{r, echo=FALSE}
inputPanel(
  sliderInput(inputId = "year",
              label = "Please select a year",
              min = 1872, max = 2010, step = 1, value = 1960)
)

renderPlot(
  ggplot(ames_housing, aes(x = input$year, y = Overall.Qual)) +
    geom_jitter()
)
```
